description: Summon a LIVE panel of frontier models (Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek) on one open question — verbatim answers, uncurated, plus the named tensions between them. Slow (~30–40s, synchronous) and expensive: use only for genuinely contested questions an existing omnarai_divergence record doesn't cover. Every run mints a new divergence record.

question.description: The open question for the live panel, phrased as you would to a human expert.

name: omnarai_council
